Trend.what: A Trend is two or more Swings in a row in one direction: {a trend} is a run of {swing}s, and begins where its first {swing} begins.
Trend.confirmed: The BoS of the second {swing} makes two in a row: that Confirms the {trend}.
Trend.weak: {a swing} with an MSB inside it, a close {beyond} the {turn} of the {swing} before, is Weak; one with none is Strong. A Weak {swing} always has an {weak turn} as its {turn}.
Trend.next: After an MSB against a Trend, the next BoS decides. {a swing}'s BoS continues the {trend} with a Weak {swing}. {a other swing}'s BoS ends it.
Trend.strength: The Strength of a Trend is the share of its Swings that are Strong.
Trend.ends: A Trend ends at the BoS of the first Swing in the opposite direction.
Trend.count: Like Successive Candles, a Trend is a count of what has happened. It does not say what the price will do next.
